fr.sorbonne_u.cps.pubsub.interfaces

Interface PrivilegedClientCI

  • All Superinterfaces:
    AdministrationI, fr.sorbonne_u.components.interfaces.ComponentInterface, fr.sorbonne_u.components.interfaces.OfferedCI, PublishingCI, java.rmi.Remote, fr.sorbonne_u.components.interfaces.RequiredCI

    public interface PrivilegedClientCI
extends PublishingCI, AdministrationI
    The component interface PrivilegedClientCI declares the methods to be offered by a publication/subscription system to its privileged clients to manage the channels.

    Description

    Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant

    Created on : 2026-01-20

    Author:
    Jacques Malenfant
